transcript: Speaker A: Don't say good morning. Say morning. How are you? No, no. Say how's it going. What happened? What's going on? I am leaving? No, say I am out. Come here? Absolutely no. Say come over. I don't care? Absolutely no. Say whatever. Want to boost your English just by practicing 15 minutes a day? summary: The ad uses a satisfying DIY video overlayed with an English teacher correcting common phrases to capture attention. It pitches the Speakeasy AI app for quick daily practice, ending with an AI avatar prompting Hindi-speaking users to download the app.
